brief.headline: Qualify a second converter now and ask Silk Polypack to match the market fair-band of ₹205–305/kg — our tiny ₹7775 spend gives us almost no leverage, so start lining up Huhtamaki or Constantia as backup.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match the pharma laminate fair band of ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg
priceAsk.basis: The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), rated MARKET-FAIR at the top of the fair band — so there's room to move down in that range while staying fair to both sides.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 in exchange for a small price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster would tie up an extra ₹320 of our cash, so the price cut must cover that cost to us.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we don't know how healthy or cash-tight they are. Our annual spend with them is only ₹7775 — we are a tiny customer, which means we have almost no pull on price or terms through volume alone. The play here is to quietly qualify a second source (Huhtamaki or Constantia are proven pharma converters) and use that as the real lever: once they know we have a credible backup ready to quote, even a small buyer gets heard.

evidence.point: Our total annual spend with Silk Polypack is very small
The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits in a fair band
evidence.figure: ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, verdict MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)

evidence.point: Import unit value for BOPET film (the substrate layer) is much lower
We currently pay them 30 days after we receive the material
Offering to pay 15 days faster would lock up this much extra cash for us

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes (₹2755.75 Cr revenue, health 58/100) — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets that we can ramp up.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health 31/100) — a strong second-source option for our pharma laminate needs.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both the film substrate and does conversion (₹16492.00 Cr revenue, health 46/100) — can second-source at scale if we need volume backup.

risks: Our ₹7775 annual spend is so small that Silk Polypack may not move much on price unless we credibly threaten to walk — get at least one alternate quoted before pushing hard.
Silk Polypack's financials aren't public, so we can't tell if they're fragile or flush — tread carefully on payment-term changes until we see how they react.
The market asking price of ₹205–305/kg is a PUBLIC range, not a quote we've received — verify it with an RFQ to Huhtamaki or Constantia before using it as the benchmark in the room.

If we squeeze too hard and Silk Polypack walks away, our ₹7775 order is too small to interest a big converter like UFLEX without a much longer lead time — have Huhtamaki or Constantia ready to go first.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing all our laminate suppliers this quarter and lining up a second source — can you help us understand how your pricing compares to the ₹205–305/kg band we're seeing in the market for pharma laminates?
